text: Coating shall follow the series of ISO 12944 (parts 1 to 9, corrosivity per ISO 12944-2), ISO 8501 (rust grades and preparation grades), ISO 8502 (tests for surface cleanliness), ISO 8503 (surface profile), ISO 19840 (dry film thickness measurement) and ISO 2808. Galvanising per EN ISO 1461 and duplex systems (galvanising and coating) per ISO 12944-5.
